save_order: Native PUSH ECX initializes the size DWORD to actual owner-pointer bits before the first query; retain it rather than initialize zero.
Capture initial owner+8; if null skip. AddRef then Release on that captured object even if owner+8 changes during AddRef.
Reload current owner+8; call actual GetFunction(nullptr,&size); pass actual size to existing CRT allocation with no HRESULT/size policy.
After allocation capture current owner+8 before publishing owner+C. Call GetFunction with allocated buffer and same size DWORD.
Reload final current owner+8; if nonnull Release it and then clear owner+8 even if Release changed the field. Leave current bytecode unchanged afterward.
restore_order: Current owner+8 nonnull skips before bytecode/global reads. Current owner+C null skips before global.
Load current renderer from actual global storage, call genuine B1FEF0 getter, reload current bytecode, and call real device Create* with actual owner+8 output cell.
Ignore HRESULT; reload current owner+C for actual free; then clear owner+C after free returns.

real_D3D9.COM_provider: Actual runtime devices and shader objects. Per-object vtable observers call original methods before controlled post-call field changes. No fake COM provider.
real_D3D9.fixture_lifetime: Four initial real shader references per input keep objects alive across observed calls; remaining held references and restored outputs are balanced at teardown.

fixture.global_gate_case: Native actual global page PAGE_NOACCESS; source global-storage argument null. Nonnull COM and empty bytecode gates reach no external service.
fixture.controlled_perturbations: Real AddRef/GetFunction/allocation/Release effects deliberately select different live actual shaders. Real Create redirects current bytecode to another live actual buffer; after actual free a further field change tests final clear. These effects are not ordinary COM/CRT behavior.
fixture.normalization: Only explicit renderer/device/shader/buffer identities and the asserted incoming owner-address size word. Raw unrelated owner fields/canaries, held refcounts, HRESULTs, sizes and all reached live bytecode bytes remain in the comparison.

uncertainty: Descriptive shader names are hypotheses; existing reviewed getter naming is preserved.
